pages.title: North Meridian — Small-batch coffee, crafted for the discerning palate.

sections.purpose: Introduce the brand’s value proposition and call to action.
sections.copy: Welcome to North Meridian, where every bean is a story. We roast small batches with care, delivering bold, nuanced flavors that reflect the terroir of our beans. Discover the difference of artisanal coffee.

sections.purpose: Build trust through credibility and community.
sections.copy: Awarded Best Coffee in Portland 2023 | Featured in *Bon Appétit* | 100% customer satisfaction

sections.purpose: Highlight the unique qualities of North Meridian’s coffee.
sections.copy: Our coffee is hand-selected, small-batch roasted, and sustainably sourced. Each bag is a testament to craftsmanship and quality.

sections.purpose: Outline the process from bean to cup.
sections.copy:
1. Select beans from trusted growers.
2. Roast in small batches to preserve flavor.
3. Deliver fresh, artisanal coffee directly to your door.

sections.purpose: Reinforce the brand’s unique benefit or a testimonial.
sections.copy: “North Meridian’s coffee is the best I’ve ever had. It’s like drinking a fine wine with every cup.” — Sarah L., Portland

sections.purpose: Answer common questions with clarity and confidence.
sections.copy:
What makes North Meridian different? 
<details><summary>Our small-batch roasting process preserves the unique flavor of each bean.</summary> We source only the finest beans and roast them with care to ensure the best possible flavor.</details>

How long does shipping take? 
<details><summary>Orders are shipped within 2 business days.</summary> We use eco-friendly packaging and deliver your coffee fresh to your doorstep.</details>

Do you offer bulk orders? 
<details><summary>Yes! We offer bulk discounts for orders of 12 bags or more.</summary> Contact us for more information about our bulk options.</details>
